zh.title: 青年運動疑襲利雅德機場 傳數十傷、多家航空停飛
zh.summary: 青年運動疑以飛彈襲擊利雅德機場；傳數十人受傷；多家航空取消航班
body: 外交消息人士向法新社透露，葉門叛軍「青年運動」（Houthis）今天疑似發射飛彈襲擊沙烏地阿拉伯利雅德（Riyadh）國際機場，傳出數十人受傷，目擊者形容航廈內部陷入恐慌。沙烏地官方並未證實任何最新攻擊行動或疏散事件。
有旅客向法新社表示，在等候登機時聽見爆炸聲，另一人則說目睹攻擊發生，現場有人受傷。一名目擊者說，他當時在國內線403登機門，看見401登機門遭擊中，眼前就有人受傷，大家都在奔跑。有3名目擊者向法新社證實，現場人員正在撤離機場。
當地醫院的消息來源透露，有5人在機場受傷後送進加護病房治療，並表示總計有數十人受傷。一名傷者家屬表示，傷者是被飛散的玻璃碎片割傷雙肩與手臂，已緊急送醫。
外交消息來源告訴法新社，青年運動現在攻擊民用目標，而利雅德機場正是民用設施；消息來源指出，機場是在當地時間下午3時左右遭飛彈擊中。沙烏地政府媒體辦公室及民航局對此事件暫未回應媒體詢問。
路透社報導，航班追蹤網站Flightradar24的資料顯示，當時所有飛往利雅德的航班均已轉降或取消，一度只有一架直升機在機場上空盤旋。利雅德機場呼籲旅客，前往機場前應直接聯繫航空公司確認航班狀態。
科威特航空（Kuwait Airways）隨後宣佈，因利雅德機場受「安全情勢」影響關閉，已取消所有往返沙烏地首都的航班。阿提哈德航空（Etihad Airways）及卡達航空（Qatar Airways）稍早也已取消多班往返各自樞紐與利雅德的航班，部分停飛措施將持續至12日。

en.title: Houthis suspected of missile strike on Riyadh airport; dozens reported hurt, airlines suspend flights
en.summary: Suspected Houthi missile strike on Riyadh airport; dozens reported injured; airlines cancel flights
body: Diplomatic sources told AFP that Yemen's Houthi rebels were suspected of firing a missile at Riyadh International Airport in Saudi Arabia on Saturday, with dozens of people reported injured and witnesses describing panic inside the terminal. Saudi officials have not confirmed any latest attack or evacuation.

Passengers told AFP they heard an explosion while waiting to board, and another said he saw the attack happen and people were injured. One witness said he was at domestic gate 403 when he saw gate 401 hit, with people injured in front of him and everyone running. Three witnesses confirmed to AFP that people on site were being evacuated from the airport.

A source at a local hospital said five people were taken to intensive care after being injured at the airport, and said dozens were injured in total. A relative of one injured person said the person suffered cuts to both shoulders and arms from flying glass fragments and was rushed to hospital.

A diplomatic source told AFP that the Houthis are now attacking civilian targets and that Riyadh airport is a civilian facility. The source said the airport was hit by a missile at around 3 p.m. local time. Saudi's government media office and civil aviation authority had not responded to media queries about the incident.

Reuters reported that data from flight tracking site Flightradar24 showed all flights to Riyadh were diverted or cancelled at the time, and for a period only one helicopter was circling over the airport. Riyadh airport urged passengers to contact their airlines directly to confirm flight status before going to the airport.

Kuwait Airways subsequently announced it had cancelled all flights to and from the Saudi capital because Riyadh airport was closed due to the "security situation." Etihad Airways and Qatar Airways had earlier cancelled multiple flights between their respective hubs and Riyadh, with some suspensions to continue until the 12th.

zh.title: 臺北101國慶展演登場 600臺無人機搭配煙火演出14分鐘
zh.summary: 臺北101國慶展演晚間10時登場；600臺無人機與煙火、燈光、雷射光束演出約14分鐘
body: 臺北101國慶展演10日晚間10時登場，以「Onward Taiwan 一起點亮臺灣」為主題，結合煙火、建築燈光與雷射光束。中央社報導指出，展演全程約14分鐘，出動600臺無人機，以1分鐘煙火揭幕，接續10分鐘無人機主秀，最後是3分鐘煙火壓軸。
臺北101表示，國慶展演邁入第3年，由臺北101與臺北市政府共同舉辦，臺新新光金控獨家贊助。臺北101董事長賈永婕表示，團隊希望將勇於突破的精神化為展演光芒，分享勇敢向前的力量；今年主題希望傳達民主與自由。
報導指出，無人機編隊依序呈現「世界聚焦」、「思想茁壯」、「芋見自由」、「攜手向前」及「自由幸福」等圖案。無人機完成展演後，接續以3分鐘煙火壓軸，伴隨音樂為國慶夜畫下句點。
展演前，臺北101、臺北市政府及臺新新光金控三大主辦單位的吉祥物，於晚間9時15分至9時30分快閃，與現場民眾互動。臺新新光金控總經理林維俊表示，連續2年獨家贊助臺北101國慶展演。

en.title: Taipei 101 National Day show features 600 drones in 14-minute display
en.summary: Taipei 101 National Day show began at 10pm; 600 drones plus fireworks, lighting and lasers over about 14 minutes
body: A National Day show at Taipei 101 began at 10pm on 10 October under the theme "Onward Taiwan," combining fireworks, building lighting and laser beams, according to Central News Agency reporting. The report said the full display ran about 14 minutes and used 600 drones, opening with one minute of fireworks, followed by a 10-minute drone main show and closing with three minutes of fireworks.

Taipei 101 said the National Day show is in its third year and is jointly organised by Taipei 101 and the Taipei City Government, with Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding as exclusive sponsor. Taipei 101 chairperson Janet Chia said the team hoped to turn a spirit of breaking through into the light of the show, and that this year's theme aimed to convey democracy and freedom.

According to the report, the drone formations presented images in sequence, including "world spotlight," "thoughts growing," "taro meets freedom," "moving forward together" and "freedom and happiness." After the drone segment, three minutes of fireworks closed the show with music.

Before the display, mascots of the three organisers, Taipei 101, the Taipei City Government and Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding, appeared from 9:15pm to 9:30pm to interact with the public. Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding general manager Lin Wei-chun said the company had been the exclusive sponsor of the Taipei 101 National Day show for two consecutive years.

zh.title: 漢莎航空座椅溫控已提供 加拿大航空OLED娛樂已投入商用
zh.summary: 漢莎航空提供座椅溫控，加拿大航空的OLED娛樂系統已投入商用
body: 客艙技術已有投入服務的案例，涵蓋個人座椅溫控、OLED機上娛樂與座椅背數位服務。漢莎航空Allegris頭等艙與商務艙座椅可讓乘客調整座椅溫度，相關系統已提供於配備Allegris的飛機。
巴西航空工業於2026年9月交付首架配備Smart Window的Praetor 600E給Flexjet。Panasonic Avionics的Astrova使用4K OLED HDR10+顯示器，並於2026年4月隨加拿大航空的空中巴士A321（ICAO機型代碼A321）投入商業服務；達美航空表示，其個人化座椅背螢幕體驗已安裝於數百架飛機。

en.title: Lufthansa Seat Climate Controls Are Available as Air Canada’s OLED System Enters Service
en.summary: Lufthansa offers seat climate controls, and Air Canada has an OLED system in commercial service.
body: Cabin technologies already in service include individual seat climate controls, OLED in-flight entertainment and personalised seatback services. Lufthansa’s Allegris First and Business Class seats let passengers regulate their own seat temperature, and the system is available on Allegris-equipped aircraft.

Embraer delivered the first Praetor 600E equipped with Smart Window to Flexjet in September 2026. Panasonic Avionics’ Astrova uses 4K OLED HDR10+ displays and entered commercial service with Air Canada in April 2026 on an Airbus A321 (ICAO type code A321). Delta Air Lines says its personalised seatback experience is installed on hundreds of aircraft.

zh.title: 達美航空統一A350客艙配置 改採275座佈局
zh.summary: 達美航空統一空中巴士A350客艙配置；曾飛三種客艙，含九架前LATAM的2-2-2商務艙
body: 達美航空（Delta Air Lines）已將其空中巴士（Airbus）A350機隊的客艙配置統一為275座，這是該公司目前就這項調整所公佈的資訊。
根據Simple Flying的報導，達美航空過去曾飛三種不同的A350客艙配置。
其中包含九架來自LATAM的A350客機，採用2-2-2商務艙配置。
報導並未說明這批客機改裝的具體時間、執行方式或成本，也未交代相關航線與交機安排。

en.title: Delta Air Lines Standardizes Airbus A350 Fleet on 275 Seats
en.summary: Delta standardizes Airbus A350 cabin layout on 275 seats; it previously flew three A350 cabins, including nine ex-LATAM jets
body: Delta Air Lines has standardized its Airbus A350 cabin configuration on 275 seats, according to Simple Flying. The report describes the standardization as replacing the carrier's earlier mixed layouts.
Simple Flying reports that Delta previously flew three different A350 cabin configurations.
Those included nine ex-LATAM jets fitted with a 2-2-2 business class layout.
The report does not state when the change was completed, how the aircraft were reconfigured, what it cost, or which routes are involved.
